caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica often means trading tarmac for high ridges where the road simply runs out of room. Up here in the cordillera, the climbs are measured not in gradients, but in the quiet space between your breaths. When the slope forces you off the saddle, the reward is immediate: a moment to stand still, listen to the wind in the grass, and watch the clouds drift through the canopy below. Send this to the friend who knows the value of a slow climb.
